tools.name: riltra_code_callees
tools.description: Symbols the anchor definition calls (same document as CLI `callees`).

limit.description: Maximum edges to return (CLI default 50, maximum 1000).

offset.description: Edges to skip before returning results (default 0).

path.description: Repository-relative path of the anchor position.

symbol.description: Optional exact SCIP symbol identity to check against the position.

tools.name: riltra_code_callers
tools.description: Call sites that reference the anchor symbol (same document as CLI `callers`); heuristic edges stay `POTENTIAL_CALL`, never promoted to `CALLS`.

limit.description: Maximum edges to return (CLI default 50, maximum 1000).

offset.description: Edges to skip before returning results (default 0).

path.description: Repository-relative path of the anchor position.

symbol.description: Optional exact SCIP symbol identity to check against the position.

tools.name: riltra_code_impact
tools.description: Reverse transitive callers of the anchor with a coverage verdict (same document as CLI `impact`); impact is plausible, not execution.

depth.description:
Maximum traversal depth (CLI default 3, 1-6). Impact takes no
destination, and unknown parameters are rejected.

limit.description: Maximum paths to return (CLI default 50, maximum 1000).

offset.description: Paths to skip before returning results (default 0).

path.description: Repository-relative path of the anchor position.

symbol.description: Optional exact SCIP symbol identity to check against the position.

tools.name: riltra_code_search
tools.description: Search indexed symbols by name (same document as CLI `search`). A missing index reports `no-index` without creating storage.

limit.description: Maximum hits to return (CLI default 50, maximum 1000).

offset.description: Hits to skip before returning results (default 0).

query.description: Symbol text to search for (the CLI's `search <repo> <symbol>` argument).

tools.name: riltra_code_trace
tools.description: Transitive call paths from the anchor, optionally to a destination (same document as CLI `trace`); paths are plausible traversal, not execution.

limit.description: Maximum paths to return (CLI default 50, maximum 1000).

offset.description: Paths to skip before returning results (default 0).

path.description: Repository-relative path of the anchor position.

symbol.description: Optional exact SCIP symbol identity to check against the position.

tools.name: riltra_health
tools.description: Environment health: bootstrap status, environment doctor, versions, capabilities, limits, and the registered repository count. Read-only; creates and opens no storage.

tools.name: riltra_knowledge_related
tools.description: One-hop knowledge relations in either direction (same document as CLI `knowledge related`); retracted relations are hidden unless requested.

direction.description:
`outbound` (authored links, the default) or `inbound` (links pointing
at the record).

generation.description:
Expected store generation; a stale value conflicts instead of serving
a shifted page.

id.description: Record id whose relations are read.

limit.description: Maximum relations to return (CLI default 50, maximum 1000).

offset.description: Relations to skip before returning results (default 0).

revision.description: Exact revision whose bindings are read (default is the current head).

tools.name: riltra_knowledge_search
tools.description: Search knowledge records by literal text (same document as CLI `knowledge search`). A missing store answers with an empty result and creates nothing.

generation.description:
Expected store generation; a stale value conflicts instead of serving
a shifted page.

limit.description: Maximum hits to return (CLI default 50, maximum 1000).

offset.description: Hits to skip before returning results (default 0).

query.description:
Literal text searched in titles and bodies (CLI
`knowledge search --query`).

tools.name: riltra_knowledge_show
tools.description: Read one knowledge revision with its evidence freshness (same document as CLI `knowledge show`). Confirmation is reported as stored provenance, never as promotion.

revision.description: Exact revision to read (CLI `--revision`; default is the current head).

tools.name: riltra_repo_list
tools.description: List registered repositories (same document as CLI `repo list`).

tools.name: riltra_repo_status
tools.description: Repository status (same document as CLI `repo status`) plus a read-only `index_status` member (same document as CLI `index status`).

query.description: Symbol text to search for (the CLI's `search <repo> <symbol>` argument).

generation.description:

revision.description: Exact revision whose bindings are read (default is the current head).

generation.description:

a shifted page.

limit.description: Maximum hits to return (CLI default 50, maximum 1000).

offset.description: Hits to skip before returning results (default 0).

query.description:
